{
  "opening_spine": {
    "pressure_source_type": "relational",
    "pressure_source": "Seren is abandoning the rehearsed wish in front of the whole assembly, shifting her sacrifice to Lirael instead, and the presiding Dohkar is about to call for the cost to be spoken aloud",
    "hook_object": null,
    "opening_beat": "Seren’s voice falters mid-invocation, her hands trembling as she glances at Lirael instead of the offering she named—everyone in the clearing goes still.",
    "rising_beats": [
      "Lirael’s fingers tighten around the ceremonial sash at her waist, the fabric biting into her palms as she realizes Seren is blurring the words to hide the wound she’s naming",
      "The presiding Dohkar’s posture shifts subtly, his gaze locking onto Seren’s hesitation before the assembly can react"
    ],
    "decision_beat": "Should she muffle her own cry behind the cloth or let the look in her eyes be the only warning?",
    "pc_career": "Sacrificiant",
    "opening_setting": "Veilwood ceremony clearing",
    "environment_elements": [
      "the deep-crimson braided spiralgrass carpet underfoot, crushed where Seren knelt",
      "the pale mated-pair trees’ weeping-willow veil-canopy, trembling in the sudden stillness"
    ],
    "interlocutor_placement": "Seren — the ward who trained with Lirael for months, her dark braid half-undone, fingers twisting the hem of her Veilweave as she hesitates over the words",
    "pc_self_presentation_beat": "Lirael adjusts the gossamer band across her mouth, slow, the way she always did before something that scared her—let the room call it reverence if it wanted to.",
    "scene_want": "Wants Seren to name the wound plainly, even if it means breaking the rite in front of everyone",
    "scene_mission": "Stop Seren from blurring the sacrifice before the presiding Dohkar calls for the cost to be spoken",
    "reader_state": {
      "knows": "Seren is abandoning her rehearsed wish to sacrifice for Lirael instead, and the presiding Dohkar is about to demand the cost be named aloud",
      "believes": "The rite’s alignment is already twisting, and Lirael must act before the Dohkar perceives the misalignment",
      "wondering": "What wound is Seren trying to hide by shifting the sacrifice?",
      "must_not_confuse": "Who is physically present (Lirael, Seren, the presiding Dohkar, Julian), what the ceremonial band does (muffles but does not seal), and why Seren’s hesitation matters (the cost must be named before the miracle)"
    },
    "pc_body_callback": "opening — stress_tic (the grandmother’s ring, twisted tight around her thumb)",
    "li_body_callback": "beat 2 — focus_tell (Julian’s hands, still as the trees, when Seren’s voice falters)",
    "staged_characters": [
      { "name": "Lirael", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_PC_OPENING_FUSION" },
      { "name": "Julian", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" },
      { "name": "Seren", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" },
      { "name": "the presiding Dohkar", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" }
    ]
  },
  "scene_skeleton": {
    "character_plus": [
      {
        "character": "Seren",
        "mode": "IN_PERSON",
        "option_id": "OPT-4",
        "expression_mode": "CONTRADICT",
        "first_mention": true,
        "visible_action": "Seren blurs the words of the sacrifice, her fingers trembling as she avoids naming Lirael’s wound aloud",
        "behavior_object_ids": ["O4"],
        "behavior_person_ids": ["pc:lirael"],
        "revelation_bridge": "Her avoidance of direct naming reveals she believes softening the wound is kinder than making it plain.",
        "pc_lens_operation": "INWARD_TRANSLATION_OF_ANOTHER_PERSONS_COST",
        "pc_interpretation": "Seren believes hiding the wound protects Lirael, even if it breaks the rite."
      },
      {
        "character": "the presiding Dohkar",
        "mode": "IN_PERSON",
        "option_id": "OPT-8",
        "expression_mode": "CONTROL",
        "first_mention": true,
        "visible_action": "The presiding Dohkar’s gaze locks onto Seren’s hesitation, his posture stiffening as he prepares to call for the cost to be spoken",
        "behavior_object_ids": [],
        "behavior_person_ids": ["named:seren"],
        "revelation_bridge": "His readiness to enforce the rite’s order shows he assumes his judgment carries authority others lack.",
        "pc_lens_operation": "EMOTIONAL_CONCLUSION_BEFORE_EVIDENCE",
        "pc_interpretation": "The Dohkar will demand the cost be named, regardless of who it hurts."
      }
    ],
    "environment_plus": {
      "target": "the deep-crimson braided spiralgrass carpet",
      "axis": "damage",
      "beat": "The crushed grass where Seren knelt is stained with the faintest trace of her blood, where her hands clenched too tight during the rehearsed invocation."
    },
    "pc_opening_fusion": {
      "character": "Lirael",
      "placement": "PC_FIRST_EMBODIED_BEAT",
      "character_angle": "Her first instinct is to muffle her own cry behind the cloth, but the look in her eyes is the only warning she can give.",
      "environment_target": "the pale mated-pair trees’ weeping-willow veil-canopy",
      "environment_axis": "absence",
      "beat": "Lirael reaches for the veil-canopy’s trembling leaves, her fingers brushing the cold bark beneath—Seren’s hesitation feels like a gust of wind through the trees, wrong and unnatural."
    }
  }
}
